title: Head of Marketing
description: We are partnering with a leading global enterprise technology company backed by marquee private equity to find their senior-most marketing leader in India.This is not a typical marketing role.You will lead a 100+ member India marketing organization spanning demand generation, Martech, digital, analytics, creative, content, events, and marketing operations serving as the operational heartbeat of the company’s global marketing capability.𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲✦ Senior-most marketing leader in India - full ownership of people, culture, and talent strategy✦ Driving one of the most ambitious AI transformation agendas in global B2B marketing✦ Operating in a global matrix with CMO-level stakeholder access across US, EMEA & APAC✦ Championing Event-Led Growth (ELG) and next-gen Martech innovation✦ Follow-the-sun delivery ownership across US–EMEA–APAC time zones𝗜𝗱𝗲𝗮𝗹 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗳𝗶𝗹𝗲→ 20+ years in B2B SaaS / enterprise technology marketing→ Proven leadership of 100+ person teams in a global matrix→ Hands-on AI adoption experience tools, workflows, capability building→ Deep familiarity with Event Technology and/or Martech ecosystems→ Executive presence | MBA / Master’s preferred→ APAC / IMEA exposure is a strong advantageThis is a rare opportunity to build something exceptional and leave a lasting mark on how global marketing operates from India.
